articles.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Methanex Corporation (the “Company” or “Methanex”) (TSX: MX) (Nasdaq: MEOH) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of US$0.185 per share. The dividend will be payable on December 31, 2026, to holders of common shares of record on December 17, 2026. […]
